descriptions.preferred: This unique selection is a weeping form, almost prostrate. It is best grown on a bank where it can cascade down to form a green mantle. Young plants should be staked to form a center stem from which the limbs can cascade. Each medium-sized leaf is a rich green with 9-11 lobes separated to the leaf base. The lower end of each lobe is very little wider than the midrib, then the lobe becomes broad but is deeply dissected to give the leaf a lacelike effect. Fall colors are a brilliant yellow-orange and crimson. -

sources.title: 绿色瀑布 Acer Japonicum 'Green Cascade'
sources.description: 绿色瀑布是美国培育的一种非常优秀的品种。 它由已 故的俄勒冈育种家 Art Wright 选育，并于 1973 年注 册。 20 世纪 50 年代晚期，该品种从"舞孔雀"自然 授粉的种子中选育出来。 这个特殊的品种枝条细软下 垂，几乎要趴在地上。 所以幼树需要用撑杆固定，使 枝条如瀑布般从上方倾泻而下。 绿色瀑布的叶片为浓 绿色，有 9-11 裂，且完全开裂至叶片基部，每个裂叶 长 8-10cm，自叶柄处向外辐射分布。 裂叶末端仅仅比 叶片中脉略宽，前端极为纤细的部分占裂叶总长的三 分之一，从这个位置开始裂叶逐渐变宽并继续分裂， 这种双重分裂的效果如蕾丝一般。 绿色瀑布的秋色也 十分惊艳，交织出黄色、橘红和深红色。

rhs.description: A deciduous large shrub or small tree, with a cascading, weeping habit and rounded, deeply cut, 9-11 lobed rich green leaves to 10cm long, brilliantly coloured red, orange and yellow in autumn. Bears long stalked clusters of red-purple flowers in spring as the leaves open, followed by brownish-red winged fruits

care.cultivation: Grow in fertile, moist but well-drained soil in sun or partial shade. See tree cultivation for further advice
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , if necessary, from late autumn to midwinter only. Train leading shoot vertically when young to obtain a weeping habit
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings in early summer

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一个独特的选育品种，具明显垂枝性，几乎呈匍匐状。 最适合栽植于坡地，使枝条自然倾泻下垂，形成绿色帷幕。 幼株应设支柱，培养出中心主干，再由其上长出的枝条向下垂瀑。 每片中等大小的叶片为浓绿色，具 9-11 个裂片，裂刻深达叶基。 每个裂片下部仅略宽于中脉，随后变宽，并再次深裂，令整片叶呈蕾丝状效果。 秋季叶色转为鲜艳的黄橙色和猩红色。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市或庭院花园、乡村风或自然式花园

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 落叶性大型灌木或小乔木，株形下垂呈瀑布状，具深裂、近圆形的 9–11 裂浓绿色叶片，叶长可达 10 厘米，秋季转为鲜艳的红、橙、黄色。 春季展叶时开红紫色花，成簇着生于长花梗上，随后结褐红色翅果。

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于肥沃、湿润但排水良好的土壤中，可处全日照或半阴环境。更多建议可参见乔木栽培说明。
care.pruning: 修剪分组 1；如有必要，仅可在晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。幼年期应将主枝向上牵引培养，以形成垂枝树形。
care.propagation: 可于秋季压条繁殖，晚冬嫁接，或于初夏进行软枝扦插。

products.title: Acer japonicum 'Green Cascade' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer japonicum 'Green Cascade ' Weeping Full Moon Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 This interesting japonicum Japanese maple was found by Art Wright in 1973 and has become a very popular tree in the nursery trade for both leaf shape and form. In early spring, ‘Green Cascade’ has bright green foliage that compliments the heavily dissected leaf. This intricate leaf structure gives a very lacy delicate look to this very hardy easy to grow tree. The shape of 'Green Cascade' is very full and mounding as it reaches around 6 ft in height and similar in width. In the autumn, ‘Green Cascade’ Japanese maple explodes in the garden with flashes of deep reds and yellows and oranges. This is a great choice for container growing or small garden areas with the need for big time color. Acer japonicum 'Green Cascade' Full Moon Japanese maple will bring a peaceful lacy appeal to your garden while having all the great fall color Acer japonicums are famous for.
